full_prompt_en: A square oil-painted winter landscape shows two walkers on a snow-covered village road beneath vivid orange trees and a deep turquoise sky. The road begins wide at the lower edge and winds into the middle distance between dark wooden houses. Its snow is pale blue and cream, scored with thin brown tracks and touches of warm reflected color. Near the lower right of center, a taller dark-clothed figure and a shorter red-coated figure walk away together along the curve. Their small silhouettes provide a human scale against the broad hill behind the village. On the left, a timber house with a gray roof sits close to the road; smaller roofs stagger toward the center. On the right, another dark house rises beside tall thin trunks, its roof carrying a cool blue patch of snow. The sloping hill in the upper middle glows yellow-orange, and a line of orange foliage crowns the left side, with slender vertical branches descending through the warm color. A few deeper rust trees stand on the right before the saturated turquoise sky. Short, visible paint strokes break up the snow, roofs, and foliage, leaving the surface lively rather than smoothly blended. Light from the low sun strikes the hillside and tree canopy from the left, while buildings, tree trunks, and parts of the road stay in blue-violet shade. The overall composition is inviting and rhythmic, using the winding road to lead through cool snow toward an unusually warm winter horizon.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形油画冬景，两位行人走在覆雪村路上，上方是鲜橙色树林与深青绿色天空。道路从下缘宽阔地开始，在深色木屋之间弯向中景。雪面呈浅蓝与奶油色，被细褐色车辙和少量暖色反光划过。下方中央偏右，一位穿深色衣服的较高人物与一位穿红外套的较矮人物沿弯路一起走远。他们的小剪影为村庄背后的宽阔山坡提供人的尺度。左侧，一间灰屋顶木屋紧靠道路；更小的屋顶向中央错落退去。右侧，另一间深色房屋立在高而细的树干旁，屋顶覆有一片冷蓝色雪。上方中部的斜坡泛出黄橙光，左侧树冠形成橙色枝叶线，细竖枝穿过暖色向下延伸。右方几棵更深锈红的树立在饱和青绿色天空前。短而可见的颜料笔触打散雪、屋顶与枝叶，使表面活跃而非平滑调和。低太阳光从左侧照亮山坡和树冠，建筑、树干与部分道路则留在蓝紫色阴影里。整体构图亲切而有节奏，以蜿蜒道路引导视线穿过冷雪，通往格外温暖的冬日地平线。
style_prompt_en: The oil painting joins vivid warm-cool color opposition with short, broken strokes and a lightly rough surface. Bright orange, yellow, and rust rise against saturated turquoise and blue-violet, while cream highlights keep the strongest contrast readable. Curving pale bands guide the eye between compact dark masses and thin upright marks. Edges are defined by changes in color and directional brushwork more than by drawn outlines; small strokes remain visible within broad areas. Low directional light warms upper and distant planes, leaving nearer recesses in luminous cool shadow. Spatial depth comes from a winding path of light and receding clusters, but the intense color preserves a decorative flatness. The mood is crisp, lively, and warmly nostalgic.
style_prompt_zh: 油画把鲜明冷暖对立、短促断续笔触和轻微粗糙表面结合。明橙、黄色与锈红从饱和青绿及蓝紫色中升起，奶油色高光让最强对比保持可读。弯曲浅色带引导视线穿过紧凑深色团块与纤细竖向笔痕。边缘更多由色彩变化和定向笔触而非勾线界定；宽阔区域内仍看得见小笔触。低角度定向光温暖上部和远处平面，让较近凹处留在明亮的冷影中。空间纵深来自弯曲的光带和渐远团簇，但强烈色彩又保持装饰性平面感。氛围清爽、活泼，带温暖怀旧气息。
theme_en: Two walkers on a snow-covered village road at sunset
theme_zh: 日落时两位行人走在覆雪村路上
name: Clarence Gagnon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
